content: Before I print anything, take another look at your design. Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged. I'll print the final part from what you send.

I checked the design again. I'm resubmitting it unchanged, because I don't have the real plate dimensions to improve it. The plate size is still a guess, so it shouldn't be printed as a final part until it's checked.
